g.title: CurrentTileMemory
g.text: Current GPU model — streamed storage + throughput instrumentation
N20K-SYS-0.1 — exact tile lifecycle, SDRAM traffic, copy reuse and scanout

g.title: cluster_fetch
g.text: Command fetch — prepared records are stored in SDRAM, not injected from host objects

g.title: cluster_load
g.text: Load one resident tile — repeat the row sequence 32 times; color then depth are scheduled in order

g.title: cluster_draw
g.text: Primitive loop — one draw drains before the next record; detailed fragment datapath is a separate view

g.title: cluster_store
g.text: Store one tile — every row and both attachments; no dirty-row suppression

g.title: cluster_io
g.text: Shared bounded memory adapters and physical controller — backpressure affects every dependent state

g.title: cluster_copy
g.text: COPY_RECT alternative — ordered outside render passes, same cache bank, depth unchanged

g.title: cluster_display
g.text: Scanout remains concurrent with the ordered pass / copy engine

g.title: submit
g.text: u32 descriptor address from packet RAM
Front / sealed targets cannot be written

g.title: entry
g.text: Empty bins still load and store attachments

g.title: row_start
g.text: Global pixel address from tile origin
No overlap with a previous tile's stores

g.title: local_load
g.text: Read row-bank outputs from prior edge
Write same 10-bit address to 3 tile banks

g.title: rows
g.text: LOAD unpack: clocked writes, one pixel
No row payload arrays or free parallel reads

g.title: reader
g.text: Extra RAM read pass → decoded fields
Readback streams from RAM into reply

g.title: draw
g.text: Serial U/V correction / texture cache / shade

g.title: store_local
g.text: Captured outputs WRITE three row banks

g.title: record
g.text: Texture descriptor only, no host pixels
Record refetched for each tile reference

g.title: clients
g.text: Texture: cache miss; Copy: direct color copy
One owned ≤16-word x32 slot per client

g.title: writer
g.text: Fill native client slot one word / edge
Publish after fill; wait for ACK

g.title: pass_done
g.text: Pass retires after final write ACK
Mark target color + shared depth valid

g.title: display_read
g.text: Two RGB565 FIFO write edges / word

g.title: pass_done->display_read
g.text: PRESENT may change front at vblank

g.title: arbitration
g.text: when other clients wait; others round-robin
One request owns the bus until complete

g.title: controller
g.text: Selected timing assumptions, not measured limits

g.title: copy_fill
g.text: All source pixels buffered before writes

g.title: copy_emit
g.text: Read scratch through native RAM port
Stream masked words into Copy slot

g.title: display_read->display_fifo
g.text: one RGB565 write / edge; slot-read bubbles

g.title: accounting
g.text: Every pass stores all 300 tiles: 1843200 useful color+depth bytes
LOAD of both attachments adds another 1843200 bytes; CLEAR avoids those reads
Boot explicitly writes both color buffers + shared depth: 2457600 bytes
29 native BSRAM =12 original +12 client slots +2 reader +3 row staging
Bulk storage mapped; bounded registers / logic ROM for small fields and arithmetic
LUT/FF physical fit and timing remain unproven; no synthesized clock claim
One active ordered executor operation; only scanout and host parsing progress independently
Host-only per-edge accept/retire observer adds no device state or memory ports
CPU prepared-record consistency checks are simulation assertions, not timed GPU validation units
Solid teal: data / request-response. Dashed blue: control. Dotted purple: reused memory.

g.title: display_pixel
g.text: SDL is a host observation; no HDMI model
